what: The registered journeys run through the runner in one world, made on a fleet hub by the platform this process serves, its starting worlds made in it once and saved, and the world reset in place to each journey's starting world before the journey. Passed when every registered journey was in the run, every journey's run record passed (every step as it expected, every operation check and every generic check on every call), and every world the run made, the one world included, was destroyed with nothing of it left in the accounts.
